sentences: I traced the swap and the biggest number moved right, so the array ended up sorted.
After comparing and swapping adjacent numbers, everything naturally falls into sorted order.
The if statement swaps bigger left numbers with smaller right ones until all are in order.
Since each pair got fixed during the loop, all three numbers became sorted by the end.
The loop runs twice and after swapping those pairs the whole array gets sorted automatically.
